name: Phi-4-multimodal-instruct-ko-speech
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-06. A finetune of microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 5.574 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence None, repo created 2025-03-12.

benchmarks.name: zeroth-korean test CER
benchmarks.config: Card table, row 'AST finetuned model(this model)' zeroth-CER 1.77 vs row 'original' (the base microsoft/Phi-4-multimodal-instruct, ~chance for Korean) 198.32; 457-sample zeroth-test. Lower is better.
